events.title: Thanksgiving is one week out — shopping for the turkey rub and injection: NO honey and NO honey-based anything (honey butter, honey glaze, hot honey). Not for the fryer. Ever.
REMINDER: Never, ever — and we mean EVER — use honey or any honey-type product on the turkey before it goes in the fryer.
